structured.answer: I'd go with Harel, the track that looks like their S&P 500 one: 0.56% fee, 13.7% a year over 3 years and 11.92% over 5. Harel is a big name I know, and for the S&P that's the lowest fee with the best 5-year number I saw. Fairly sure, but I never actually saw that card's title clearly (it was cut off between two screens). I only know it's the S&P because its numbers look like Mor's "עוקב מדד S&P500".

findings.what: Too many look-alike cards (143), no way to just compare the S&P tracks. I stopped after 3 companies.
Track name scrolls off while the numbers are still on screen, so I lost which card was which
No fee in shekels. 0.56% vs 0.71% feels the same to me.
"פחות מ־3 שנים" looks like a missing number and makes the card look broken
Stocks % and מט"ח % next to each other, both 99%, confusing
No 'what do I do now' or how-to-open step
Small print up top about dates and data source. I didn't read it.
